vb_textbox.text: Any gnome can have any number so you need to check which is the highest as you play the game. If the number is 7 or 8 then stick to that gnome colour, if the number goes down to 3 or below then it might be worth changing the colour. I found that the purple and pink gnomes were higher scoring in a pair but you can also get 0 from gnomes so there is a bit of randomness. Keep focused in the middle of the game so you do not get distracted and forget about the previous gnome numbers.
